raw_response:
The issuer shows adequate near-term liquidity (current ratio 1.39) and a meaningful equity base (~29% of assets), which supports balance-sheet resilience. However, profitability is modest relative to its large asset and liability base (EBIT of 886M on 73,988M of assets), and zero retained earnings suggests limited internal capital accumulation, keeping credit quality toward the low end of investment grade.

DECISION: BBB-
